note: NECO Accounting round 2 (Round 18 lift): numeric mini-computations (straight-line N11,000, markup N1,000, margin 40%, profit-from-capital N14,000, 2:1 share N60k/N30k, imprest refund N3,200, net purchases N39,000), books (journal proper, three-column cash book, discount allowed, petty cash analysis), ledger tech (debit balance, carriage inwards/outwards, closing revenue accounts, returns outwards), errors (original entry, compensating, suspense clearing), controls (purchases/sales ledger control, error location), final accounts (bad debts, drawings, snapshot nature, post-dated cheque), statement of affairs, non-profit (accumulated fund, bar account), manufacturing (indirect labour, cost of goods manufactured), audit, PAYE, net pay, dividend, current ratio. Scanned against NECO round 1, the WAEC twin and the JAMB Accounting banks.
